new_findings.description: The plan-level validation block still runs `cargo test -p sc-jev-check --test run_response ...` and `--test multi_backend ...` without `--features test-util`. Those targets are now `[[test]] required-features = ["test-util"]`. Cargo rejects or skips a target whose required feature is off, so the plan's own commands fail. The dispositions row for REQ-QA-R1-005 says the validation lines gained the flag, which is only true in the sprint docs.
new_findings.remediation: Add `--features test-util` to plan.md:776-778. Check the other plan.md validation blocks for sc-agent-http, sc-jev, sc-jev-backends and sc-ai targets.

It is stale relative to the 'Test seams' paragraph. The dispositions row 47 claims only the r-2 boundary-map cell was updated.
new_findings.remediation: Delete the sentence or mark it 'not taken; outcome 4'.

new_findings.description: The adrs list mixes ADR ids with a free-text quoted entry ('plus the r-1 interim amendment ...'). The YAML is valid. The plan-QA check at plan.md:119 and any tooling that resolves each adrs entry to an ADR id may flag the string. Also the inserted bullets use the label '(Active, r-2)', '(Active, r-3)' and not the '(Proposed, r-N)' convention the rest of the doc uses, so any scanner counting '(Proposed, r-N)' markers will not match them.
new_findings.remediation: Move the interim-amendment note into a trailing comment on the ADR-0014 line or into prose. Replace it with the concrete amendment id once r-1 lands it. Optionally state in the sprint doc that the '(Active, r-N)' labels are the post-flip form.

new_findings.description: `test_release_build_refuses_http` now runs only with `--features test-util` (target `ureq` has required-features). Its name and intent are 'release build refuses http'. Running it with the test-util feature on means it does not exercise a build without that feature.
new_findings.remediation: Add a note that `Endpoint::parse` is feature-independent, which is why the test is valid. Alternatively add a `--lib` unit test for the parse refusal that runs without test-util.
